list.text: Let me demonstrate the power of the Pokémon I caught!
I want to become the Trainer Champ using the Pokémon I caught.\nThat's the best part of fishing!
Mt. Mortar\nWaterfal Cave Inside
Route 42\nMahogany Town to Ecruteak City
Hey!\nThis is my secret place!\nGet lost, you outsider!
You're working on a Pokédex?\nWow, you must know some pretty rare Pokémon!\nMay I please see it? Please?
What's the other side of Mt. Mortar like, do you know?
If you can beat me, I'll let you know.
I said a pretty boastful lie. I'm sorry!
There's this huge waterfall in the way, so I've never been on the other side of Mt. Mortar!

lines: Trying to fix a bug I was not able to replicate

list.text: \f[faceKris]\rHey \PN!
\f[faceKris]\rGood to see you again!
\f[faceKris]\rAre you catching many Pokémon, like we asked for?\nLet me evaluate your Pokédex.
\f[faceKris]\rHmm, let's see..\nYou've seen \v[1] Pokémon, and you've caught \v[2] Pokémon!

then.text: \f[faceKris]\rThat's not enough... It really seems you don't care enough about catching Pokémon...
\f[faceKris]\rI think you should go back and catch a few more Pokémon. At least 35 Pokémon, or I'll ask for you to return the Pokédex.

else.text: \f[faceKris]\rThat's a good amount! You're still behind me, but it's a good start!
\f[faceKris]\rHope next time we see each other you have at least 50!

Sorry that I bumped into you.
Did I hurt you?
